name: ks-agent-limit
description: Caps how many Claude sessions and agents run at once on this machine: every open session and every live agent holds a slot, and a spawn past the limit is refused and reported

max_parallel.title: Parallel limit
max_parallel.description: Slots on this machine: every open Claude session and every live agent (subagent, teammate, workflow agent) holds one.

retry_minutes.title: Retry after (minutes)
retry_minutes.description: How long a refused spawn tells the model to wait before it checks for a free slot again.
